our_interpretation: This reports the authors' contemporary experiment with the quoted ellipsis prompt, rather than all possible prompts about eating.
Score three components separately: the woman's eating action, an apple incorrectly assigned to the man's mouth, and whether each person eats the specified different food.
Most cases means more than half. Often and not reliably are qualitative claims of recurring errors; no numerical cutoff is supplied for them.
The surrounding phrase presently doing is interpreted as June 2022 through publication. June 1 through June 22 is an approximate observation window; the actual experiment dates are unknown.
The prompt and experimental setting define the observation's scope. They are not antecedents of a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Independently assessed original records show recurring failures to depict the woman eating, recurring apple-to-man assignment errors, and incorrect distinct food assignments in more than half of trials.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The complete records show reliable depiction of the woman eating an apple and the man eating a sandwich, with apple-to-man errors rare and the claimed majority failure absent. Results that validate only some components warrant a mixed assessment.
